claim: Briyosis, Briyo's parent company, was established in 2006 as a contract manufacturer of softgel capsules; the Briyo Supplements brand emerged from this manufacturing base.
stance_target: Briyo corporate origin and manufacturing history
scope_conditions: Third-party trade magazine (SiliconIndia, July 2022); based on founder interviews
quoted_support: Briyo Supplements is a line of nutritional supplements, produced by its parent company Briyosis, which was established in 2006. Originally founded as a contract manufacturer of softgel capsules, Briyosis evolved into a company that produces its own supplements.

claim: Briyosis is a USFDA-registered facility that also manufactures gelatin, the primary ingredient of softgel capsules.
stance_target: Briyosis/Briyo US regulatory standing and vertical integration
quoted_support: They have also been able to diversify operations and become a USFDA-registered facility manufacturing the primary ingredient of softgel capsules — Gelatine.

claim: Briyo Supplements conducts third-party testing for product purity, projected efficacy, ingredient safety, nutritional value, and label accuracy.

quoted_support: We deliver one of the purest supplements which are third party tested for Product Purity, Projected Efficacy, Ingredient Safety, Nutritional Value, and Label Accuracy.
